repo_selectDescription: Choose the local GitHub repository that enbu should manage.
init_description: This repository hasn't been set up with enbu yet.
init_gitDescription: enbu works in a Git repository. Run this in the folder, then check again.
init_remoteDescription: enbu keeps the secrets in the GitHub Container Registry of the repository's GitHub remote. Add one (for example with git or gh), or name another storage in enbu.toml, then check again.
dashboard_duplicateKey: Key "{key}" already exists. Edit the existing secret instead.
dashboard_pullDescription: Pull secrets from storage into the output file.
dashboard_pullKept: Kept local variables enbu does not store: {keys}
dashboard_pullRemoved: Removed variables the environment no longer has: {keys}
dashboard_pullReplaceDescription: enbu cannot read this file as dotenv, so it cannot tell your local variables apart. Overwriting replaces its whole content with the environment's secrets.
environments_deleteDescription: The environment is removed from enbu.toml for everyone once the change is committed.
environments_currentCannotBeDeleted: Switch to another environment before deleting this one.
environments_purge: Also delete its stored revisions (admin only, cannot be undone)
environments_kept: Deleted {name}. Its stored revisions remain in storage.
environments_purgeEarlierDescription: An environment deleted without its revisions leaves them in storage. An admin can delete them by the incarnation shown when it was deleted (also in enbu.toml's Git history).
history_empty: No revisions changed this environment yet.
history_restored: Restored revision {index} as a new revision.
conflicts_description: These secrets were changed differently at the same time. Nothing was lost. Choose one value for each to continue.
conflicts_undecided: Choose a value for every secret.
auth_browserInstruction: Complete authorization in the GitHub page opened in your browser.
members_pendingHint: Compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the new device before approving.
members_approveWarning: An approved device can read every secret in this workspace.
members_fingerprintMatches: The fingerprint matches the one on the new device.
members_removeHint: Secrets are re-encrypted without this device. Rotate secrets it has already read.
members_grantAdminWarning: An admin can approve and remove devices, and so decide who can read every secret.
members_fingerprintConfirmed: I confirmed this fingerprint with its owner.
device_upgradeHint: Creates a hybrid ML-KEM key and keeps this device's fingerprint. A member's new key waits for an admin's approval.
device_upgradePending: Ask an admin to approve the key update. Fingerprint: {fingerprint}
device_upgraded: Switched to the post-quantum key and re-encrypted every environment.
device_hardwareUnavailable: Hardware key storage ({backend}) is not available: {reason}
device_keyringAvailable: The OS keyring can hold keys.
device_keyringUnavailable: The OS keyring is not available: {reason}
import_description: Add every variable of a .env file
import_overwriteTitle: Replace secrets with the file's values?
import_overwriteDescription: These secrets already hold another value: {keys}
config_invalidToml: Fix the TOML errors before switching to the GUI editor.
transfer_steps_encrypt: Encrypting for every member with age...
transfer_steps_push: Publishing the signed revision to storage...
error_not_authenticated: Sign in with GitHub to continue.
error_authentication_expired: The authentication session expired. Try again.
error_not_initialized: Set up enbu for this repository first.
error_config_protected: "{key}" in enbu.toml cannot be changed here: it decides which members the workspace trusts or where secrets are stored.
error_artifact_not_found: The requested secrets were not found.
error_not_member: This device has not been approved yet. Ask an admin to approve it.
error_untrusted_state: Stored data failed signature verification and was not used.
error_rollback_detected: Storage shows less than this device already accepted. It may be a delayed listing; try again.
error_incompatible_storage: This storage was created without a workspace control. Use an empty location.
error_secret_conflict: Concurrent edits changed the same secret differently. Nothing was lost; choose a value to continue.
error_control_forked: Two admins changed the members at the same time. An admin must join the changes (Join member changes on the Members tab, or "enbu member resolve-fork") before anything else can proceed.
error_reencrypt_incomplete: Membership changed, but some secrets are not re-encrypted yet. Run sync to finish.
error_identity_unavailable: No usable identity backend on this device: {reason}. Run 'enbu doctor' for details.
error_output_unreadable: {file} is not a dotenv file enbu can read. Pull again and overwrite it to replace its content.
error_trust_root_changed: enbu.toml names a different trust root (control_genesis) than this device trusts for this workspace. Do not continue unless an admin confirms out of band that they re-created the workspace; then run 'enbu init --accept-new-genesis'.
